locations.label: Sewing-room power switch
locations.description: From spawn, the broken starting elevator drops you toward the lower floor. Cross to the power building using the broken passages and mattress landing, then turn on the switch beside the sewing machines. Its elevators now move and carry perks or Pack-a-Punch between floors. Ride upward to reach the dragon roof. Before any drop, identify a visible landing and how you will get back; an arbitrary long fall kills you. Area shown on an original schematic; use these landmark directions for the exact interaction.

locations.label: Power-building elevator machines
locations.description: Read which machine is in each elevator rather than assuming a fixed shaft. Spawn-side elevators carry Quick Revive, Speed Cola and Who’s Who; the power-building group carries Jugger-Nog, Double Tap, Mule Kick and Pack-a-Punch. Buy or upgrade when it has just arrived and remains stationary, then step clear. Bells and closing doors warn it is about to move; staying on its roof at the top of a shaft crushes you. Area shown on an original schematic; use these landmark directions for the exact interaction.

locations.description: Read which machine is in each elevator rather than assuming a fixed shaft. Buy or upgrade when it has just arrived and remains stationary, then step clear. Bells and closing doors warn it is about to move; staying on its roof at the top of a shaft crushes you. locations.label: Roof tower / final symbols
locations.description: The pylon leg beside the photographed tile spawn is North (the side facing away from the Power Building), even if that spawn is empty. Orient yourself from that fixed anchor; screen-left and screen-right change when you walk around the tower. With Galvaknuckles, strike the four legs once each in the decoded 1–4 order. A wrong attempt extinguishes the glow and requires the next round before retrying. Electricity over the whole tower, the achievement and all perks confirm the selected route. Area shown on an original schematic; use these landmark directions for the exact interaction.
